label: Picture Format (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'Picture Tools' family; exists only while: an inline picture is selected. Groups: Adjust, Picture Styles, Accessibility, Arrange, Size. Appeared on the 'picture' probe.

children.label: Remove Background
children.tooltip:
Automatically remove unwanted portions of the picture.

If needed, use marks to indicate areas to keep or remove from the picture.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, E 1; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Corrections
children.tooltip: Improve the brightness, contrast, or sharpness of the picture.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Color
children.tooltip: Change the color of the picture to improve quality or match document content.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, I; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Artistic Effects
children.tooltip: Add artistic effects to the picture to make it look more like a sketch or painting.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Transparency
children.tooltip: Adjust the transparency of the picture to allow what is behind it to be seen.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, T 1; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Compress Pictures...
children.tooltip: Compress pictures in the document to reduce its size.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, M; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Change Picture
children.tooltip: Remove or replace the selected picture, while maintaining the size and position of the picture object.
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, E 2; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Reset Picture
children.state_notes: group 'Adjust'; keytip Alt, J P, Q; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: PictureStylesGallery
children.tooltip:
Change the overall look of your picture.

The predefined styles make it easy for you to explore different looks. Hover over a style in the gallery to preview it in your document.
children.state_notes: group 'Picture Styles'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Picture Border
children.tooltip: Pick the color, width, and line style for the outline of your shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Picture Styles'; keytip Alt, J P, S O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Picture Effects
children.tooltip: Apply a visual effect to the picture, such as a shadow, glow, reflection, or 3-D rotation.
children.state_notes: group 'Picture Styles'; keytip Alt, J P, F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Picture Layout
children.tooltip: Convert the selected pictures to a SmartArt graphic to easily arrange, caption, and resize the pictures.
children.state_notes: group 'Picture Styles'; keytip Alt, J P, C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Picture...
children.tooltip: Show the Format Picture dialog box to adjust picture settings such as brightness, contrast, and compression.
children.state_notes: group 'Picture Styles'; keytip Alt, J P, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Alt Text
children.tooltip: Create text descriptions of objects for screen readers.
children.state_notes: group 'Accessibility'; keytip Alt, J P, A T; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Position
children.tooltip:
Choose where the selected object will appear on the page.

Text will automatically wrap around the object so that it's still easy to read.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, P O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Wrap Text
children.tooltip:
Choose how your text wraps around the selected object.

For example, you can choose to have the text continue around the object or cross right over it.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, T W; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Bring Forward
children.tooltip: Bring the selected object forward one level, or bring it in front of all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Send Backward
children.tooltip: Send the selected object back one level, or send it behind all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Selection Pane...
children.tooltip:
See a list of all your objects.

This makes it easier to select objects, change their order, or change their visibility.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align
children.tooltip:
Change the placement of your selected objects on the page.

This is great for aligning objects to the margins or the edge of the page. You can also align them relative to one another.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Group
children.tooltip: Join objects together to move and format them as if they were a single object.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Rotate
children.tooltip: Rotate or flip the selected object.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J P, A Y; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Crop
children.tooltip:
Crop your picture to remove any unwanted areas.

Check out the dropdown for more options such as cropping to a specific shape or aspect ratio.
children.state_notes: group 'Size'; keytip Alt, J P, V; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: More
children.tooltip: Change the height of the shape or picture.
children.state_notes: group 'Size'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)
